findings.evidence: Repository-wide `rg` finds the three declarations used only in this defining file and the new private proofs at `CongruenceSubgroups.lean:172,175,179,248,254`; Mathlib already provides `SL2_inv_expl` at `Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/SpecialLinearGroup.lean:379`.
findings.fix: Keep these helpers private and prove equivalent private coordinate lemmas in `CongruenceSubgroups.lean` directly from `SL2_inv_expl`, `coe_mul`, and `Matrix.mul_apply`.
findings.issue: `inv_apply_one_zero`, `inv_apply_one_one`, and `mul_apply_one_zero` are exposed solely to support this PR’s internal coset calculations, duplicating `SL2_inv_expl` and generic matrix multiplication while leaving the parallel coordinate lemmas private.

summary: The index theorems form an appropriate public API, but three proof-specific coordinate helpers unnecessarily enlarge the general special-linear-group surface.
